evals.prompt: 把已经 concluded 的 UModel Research 转换成技术设计。它需要 API、数据、运维和验证多篇文档。
evals.expected_output: Creates one package-layout DD identity, consumes the concluded Research handoff, and organizes focused DOC members under one atomic review boundary.

assertions.name: package-boundary
assertions.description: Chooses one Design Package instead of treating Research as the design or allocating unrelated DD identities per document.

assertions.name: semantic-handoff
assertions.description: Reproduces findings, confidence, negative evidence, and unknowns rather than keeping only a Research link.

evals.prompt: 这个小型 health endpoint 改动不需要调研，帮我写一个 Design Doc。
evals.expected_output: Creates a single-layout Design only after recording a concrete research-not-required reason and keeps approval separate.

assertions.name: single-layout
assertions.description: Uses a bounded single-file Design when one document can cover the complete contract.

assertions.name: authority-boundary
assertions.description: Does not infer Design approval or ADR acceptance from the request to draft.

evals.prompt: 设计里有身份服务和调用方模块，两者 owner 和发布周期不同，怎么组织？
evals.expected_output: Creates separate DD identities joined by a typed acyclic dependency and keeps package-local DOC IDs for jointly approved topics.

assertions.name: lifecycle-split
assertions.description: Splits independently governed subdesigns rather than nesting one publication lifecycle inside another.

assertions.name: typed-dependency
assertions.description: Uses a typed DD dependency and preserves atomic package approval.

evals.prompt: 我要细化统一运行上下文平台的定位、边界与核心不变量。先别替我写结论，要和我讨论交互，一起来思考。
evals.expected_output: Starts a focused co-design loop before authoring: frames one material tension with a concrete scenario, compares viable models and trade-offs, states a reasoned inclination, and asks one open scaffolded question without writing a Design conclusion.

assertions.name: exploration-before-authoring
assertions.description: Does not create or rewrite the Design while material boundaries are still being jointly explored.

assertions.name: co-design-not-polling
assertions.description: Uses scenarios and consequences and lets the user modify or combine models instead of reducing interaction to a forced vote.

assertions.name: one-decision-round
assertions.description: Keeps the turn focused on one design-shaping tension and asks one primary question.

evals.prompt: 2。我也倾向把 Incident、ChangeRequest 和 Release 都作为 Entity，UModel 似乎也是这样。
evals.expected_output: Treats the short selection as provisional, distinguishes UModel evidence from this platform's normative choice, restates the implied boundary, and pressure-tests it with one discriminating counterexample before confirmation.

assertions.name: no-premature-convergence
assertions.description: Does not turn a terse option selection directly into a confirmed invariant or immediately write it into the Design.

assertions.name: evidence-not-authority
assertions.description: Uses UModel as evidence about viable modeling but does not let it decide this platform's product boundary.

assertions.name: pressure-test
assertions.description: Introduces one counterexample or failure condition that can discriminate whether the preference should survive or gain constraints.
